title: Nuh 71:5-10 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 37 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Nuh 71:5-10 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 37. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا (٥) فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا (٦) وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا (٧)
ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا (٨) ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا (٩) فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

questions.q: Chunk and link Nuh 71:5-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 71:5-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 71:5-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the ways Nuh called his people in 71:5 to 9.
questions.a: By night and day; publicly; openly and in private.

questions.q: Why is «كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا» (71:10) encouraging for a sinner?
questions.a: Allah is perpetually Forgiving: istighfar is always welcome.

questions.q: What did his people do when Nuh called them (71:7)?
options: Put their fingers in their ears and covered themselves
questions.a: A) Put their fingers in their ears and covered themselves. 71:7.

questions.q: Nuh 71:8: «ثُمَّ إِنِّى ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Nuh tried calling his people by night and by day, in public and in private. Why do you think he tried so many ways?
questions.a: Different people respond to different ways; he used every wise method, out of care for them.
